'''''Storm''''' was a group of 3 [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]]s that were used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] carrying [[Commando/Legends|commandos]]. They were part of a unsuccessful capture operation to disable a [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|freighter]] called ''[[Mharsup]]'' that carried [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]] prototypes. Despite [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] escort, they were all destroyed by [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].
